thread:
Jordan (PM): Quick sync: did a pass on the routing policies editor preview — a handful of UX/accessibility smalls that would be great to fix before the next demo.
Rae (Design): cool, drop the list.
Jordan (PM): 1) Reorder feedback: after moving a rule via keyboard the app only reads 'button' which doesn't help. 2) Empty-state copy is terse. 3) Preview simulator slider defaults to 100% which is surprising when you want to test canaries.
Priya (A11y): for 1) we need an aria-live polite region announcing "<rule> moved to position <n>". keep it short and avoid punctuation that screenreaders expand.
Ibrahim (Frontend): fine by me. technical Q: do we use the rule label or fallback to "Rule #" when label missing?
Rae (Design): prefer label when present, otherwise say "unnamed rule" not "Rule #". UX-wise labels feel friendlier. Also cap label length in the announcement (first 35 chars) and add ellipsis.
Nate (QA): repro: focus sometimes lands on the drag handle placeholder after reordering. That confuses keyboard users.
Ibrahim (Frontend): yeah that's a timing issue — the DOM node gets moved during the animation. I'll ensure we set focus programmatically on the moved item after the reorder completes.
Priya (A11y): also expose arrow-key reordering when the handle has focus (aria-keyshortcuts: ArrowUp ArrowDown). Users expect inline keyboard moves.
Rae (Design): widen the handle hit area so the focus ring is visible and easier to target. Also update tooltip for the handle to include the keyboard hint.
Jordan (PM): copy: change validation text from "Rule invalid" to a friendly actionable line e.g., "Add a condition so this rule can match traffic." and for the empty state use "No routing rules yet — create one to start directing traffic."
Rae (Design): I'll drop suggested copy into the copy doc.
Ibrahim (Frontend): slider default: we can change it to 10% when you open the simulator from a newly created rollout. Should we also persist user changes?
Jordan (PM): yes persist per-session, but default to 10% for new rollouts. Update tooltip: "Default sim mirrors a small canary (10%)."
ci-bot: Staging deploy for branch feat/route-editor-a11y at 2147598900 succeeded
Nate (QA): I'll add regression tests for keyboard reorder, focus landing, and slider default/persistence.
Priya (A11y): I'll rerun NVDA/VO passes after the deploy.
Ibrahim (Frontend): plan: 1) add aria-live announcement + label truncation, 2) programmatic focus after reorder, 3) arrow-key moves + expanded hit area, 4) slider default change. PR aim: Friday.
Rae (Design): I'll push the copy and small design tweaks by tomorrow.
Jordan (PM): thanks everyone. small fixes but will make the editor feel way more reliable in demos.
